description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllGnJubakuStsu]{Magen: Jubaku Satsu}.

You believe you are tied to a nearby surface by branches/wires/chains of chakra. You have the immobilized condition (or paralyzed on a critical failure of the originating save). The illusion ends if you take real damage from a source other than the binding caster's reinforcement actions.

An ally may attempt to free you by Treating you (Medicine DC 15 + spell rank) or by casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-actions.Item.ClAcGenjutsuRels]{Genjutsu Release}.
